**3B.3 Research Note**

Overall: I found **limited direct evidence** of Erdoğan personally inciting hatred/dehumanization in 2024. The strongest negative material is **brinkmanship and coercive hostility toward Israel and war dynamics**, not classic hate-incitement language against journalists, minorities, migrants, or civil society. The strongest positive material is **repeated ceasefire, diplomacy, and restraint rhetoric**.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [Erdoğan says Turkey might “enter Israel” to help Palestinians](https://www.voanews.com/a/erdogan-says-turkey-might-enter-israel-to-help-palestinians/7716248.html) | Reuters via VOA | 2024-07-28 | https://www.voanews.com/a/erdogan-says-turkey-might-enter-israel-to-help-palestinians/7716248.html | Erdoğan’s “we might enter Israel” comment is the clearest 2024 example of coercive, escalation-prone rhetoric. It is not explicit hate speech, but it does cross into personal-strength signaling and threat language. | 3B.3; 2B.8 |
| Negative | [Turkey’s Erdoğan hopes Trump will tell Israel to stop war](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-hopes-trump-will-tell-israel-to-stop-war-3710867) | Reuters | 2024-11-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-hopes-trump-will-tell-israel-to-stop-war-3710867 | Erdoğan used hard-edged anti-Israel rhetoric and pressure language. This shows hostility and antagonistic framing, but still stops short of direct dehumanization or calls for civilian violence. | 3B.3; 2B.7 |
| Positive | [Türkiye president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan UNGA remarks](https://www.un.org/unispal/document/turkiye-president-recep-tayyip-unga-79-24sep24/) | UN / UNISPAL | 2024-09-24 | https://www.un.org/unispal/document/turkiye-president-recep-tayyip-unga-79-24sep24/ | Erdoğan’s UN speech centered on Gaza’s humanitarian catastrophe, a ceasefire, and stopping escalation. This is the clearest counterevidence to a reading of Erdoğan as personally inciting hatred or revenge in 2024. | 3B.3; 2B.7 |
| Positive | [Erdoğan says Türkiye was ready to act as guarantor and push for a ceasefire and lasting peace in Gaza](https://www.tccb.gov.tr/en/news/542/152994/-global-peace-and-stability-cannot-be-addressed-without-a-lasting-solution-to-the-israel-palestine-issue-) | Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications | 2024-07-12 | https://www.tccb.gov.tr/en/news/542/152994/-global-peace-and-stability-cannot-be-addressed-without-a-lasting-solution-to-the-israel-palestine-issue- | Erdoğan framed Türkiye as a guarantor for ceasefire and lasting peace, which cuts against personal incitement to violence and supports a diplomatic reading. | 3B.3; 2B.7 |
| Positive | [Erdoğan opposes Ukraine use of US long-range missiles, urges restraint](https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/foreign-policy/1253952/erdogan-opposes-ukraine-use-of-us-long-range-missiles-urges-restraint/) | Reuters via Reuters-syndicated reporting | 2024-11-20 | https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/foreign-policy/1253952/erdogan-opposes-ukraine-use-of-us-long-range-missiles-urges-restraint/ | Erdoğan argued that deeper strikes would inflame the war and provoke retaliation. That is restraint language, not incitement. | 3B.3; 2B.7 |

**Search gap**

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence in the reviewed material that Erdoğan personally urged violence against journalists, migrants, ethnic/religious minorities, or civil society in the explicit hate-incitement sense this lens asks about. The evidence I found is mostly:
- combative foreign-policy rhetoric,
- pressure politics,
- and separate institutional repression cases that are better captured under 3B.1 and 3B.2 than under 3B.3.
